basis: synthesis-plan.auto.json decisions from the first no-tools adjudication

repairs.change: Canonicalized presentation-equivalent RFC 5646, RFC 4647 and UTS #35 URLs during split merge; source count changed from 35 to 32 and duplicate source references were stable-deduplicated.
Restated localization binding identity as host-dependent weak identity keyed by host object reference, target field/resource path and monotonic binding version.
Replaced the local allow/deny authorization function with an advisory role-eligibility check; the external authorization component retains decision and enforcement ownership.
Reconciled disclosure language with schema-supported bundle, layer, finding and artifact scopes; removed unsupported field-level authorization claims.
Extended serial naming and immutable revision rules to all eleven artifacts marked serial.
Reclassified the IANA registry artifact as an externally owned snapshot reference plus optional read-only cache manifest.

Reclassified the ISO 30042 catalogue record to non-primary tier 2 edition evidence, limited CLDR 36 to historical pseudo-region provenance, and downgraded retention-and-deletion coverage to a declared gap.
Reclassified disclosure and retention questions at their operative semantic grains, yielding three access and four retention questions without adding unsupported nodes.

Replaced the fallback-chain artifact's bare profile-name key with an authoritative profile-register identifier, governed IRI or UUID/ULID qualified by revision; names, language ranges, content classes and dates are qualifiers only.
